title: Best Damn YouTube Scraper input
description: Paste YouTube channel, playlist or video URLs and/or search terms. Every video (or channel, in channel mode) delivered is one billable result; inputs that cannot be read are reported free of charge.

startUrls.title: YouTube URLs
startUrls.description: One per line. Channel URLs (youtube.com/@handle, youtube.com/channel/UC...) or @handles return the channel's latest uploads; playlist URLs (youtube.com/playlist?list=...) return the playlist; video, Shorts and youtu.be URLs or bare video IDs return that video.

searchQueries.title: Search terms
searchQueries.description: Optional. Find videos by keyword, exactly like the YouTube search box. Each term returns up to "Max results" videos.

maxResults.title: Max results per channel, playlist or search
maxResults.description: How many videos to take from each channel, playlist or search term (newest first for channels). Use 0 for all of them (search is limited to 500 by YouTube).

publishedAfter.title: Only videos published after
publishedAfter.description: Optional. A date (2026-01-31) or a relative period such as "7 days", "2 weeks" or "6 months". Applies to channels, playlists and search.

outputMode.title: Output
outputMode.description: "Videos" returns one record per video with its statistics and channel stats. "Channels" returns one record per channel (subscribers, total views, video count, country, description) without listing videos.

searchDuration.title: Search video length
searchDuration.description: Short: under 4 minutes. Medium: 4 to 20 minutes. Long: over 20 minutes.

searchRegion.title: Search country
searchRegion.description: Optional two-letter country code (US, GB, DE, IN...) to get the results people in that country see.

searchLanguage.title: Search language
searchLanguage.description: Optional two-letter language code (en, es, de...) to prefer videos in that language.

maxDescriptionLength.title: Max description length
maxDescriptionLength.description: Cut video descriptions to this many characters to keep exports small. 0 keeps the full description.

apiKey.title: YouTube API key
apiKey.description: Optional. Your own free YouTube Data API v3 key (Google Cloud Console > APIs & Services > Credentials, with the YouTube Data API v3 enabled). Without it the Actor uses a shared key whose daily quota is shared by all users and allows up to 5 search terms and 100 search results per term per run; with your own key you get 10,000 quota units a day to yourself.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: How many channels, playlists or searches to read in parallel.
